provenance: Artificial mutations of pinned python-dotenv v1.1.1 production source. These are controlled repair tasks, not historical upstream issues or SWE-bench tasks.

tasks.old: default = self.default if self.default is not None else ""
tasks.prompt: Variable interpolation ignores the configured default when an environment variable is absent. Restore default handling while preserving existing environment values.
Literal atoms lose their text during resolution. Restore literal resolution without altering variable expansion.

tasks.old: return result if result is not None else ""
tasks.prompt: An environment variable set to None expands to the text None. It should expand to an empty string while ordinary values retain their contents.
Variable parsing drops trailing literal text and strings without placeholders. Restore complete text preservation.
Interpolating placeholders leaves parts of the original placeholder in the result. Repair iteration boundaries for adjacent and embedded placeholders.
Unquoted dotenv values retain trailing whitespace after parsing. Restore trailing whitespace trimming and keep inline comment handling.
Quoted values retain supported backslash escapes literally. Restore quote-specific escape decoding while preserving literal unquoted text.
Parser bindings always report line 1. Restore correct original line tracking for LF and CRLF input.

tasks.old: if k in os.environ and not self.override:
tasks.prompt: DotEnv refuses to replace an existing environment variable even with override=True. Restore the override option while preserving override=False behavior.
The interpolate=False option is ignored and literal placeholders are expanded. Honor the option while keeping normal interpolation enabled by default.
